_comment: Candidate facts for target outreach drafts (src/targets/pitch-facts.js). Copy to target-pitch-facts.json (gitignored, personal data) in this directory and fill it in. Drafts may state candidate facts ONLY from this file. Rules: one plain sentence per fact; ids c1..c12; NO current-employer detail (the loader refuses a fact tagged employer, a fact that talks about the current employer, or a fact that names a blocked party); no compensation figures. signoff is added by code on copy and is not counted in the 90 words. candidate_names are never allowed in a draft body. denylist phrases are never allowed in a draft body. While _placeholder is true the file is refused (facts_placeholder).
